crownPassive.name: Enchantress
crownPassive.text: You start the fight with the Fate token (unless the enemy Crown is Renfield). In rounds when you hold it, enemy Bonds don't work.

bond.name: Bane of Camelot
bond.text: Her Spells deal +1 to Sovereigns, Guardians and Slayers, and enemy Sovereigns have -1 Speed.

actions.name: Hex
actions.text: A Spell for 2 on any enemy card, ignoring Guard.

actions.name: Stolen scabbard
actions.text: An enemy hero loses its Guard and can't be healed for the rest of the fight.
